description: Sends a message from a user to the VertoDigital team, delivered to the team's CRM and inbox, and returns a reference ID; the team replies to fromEmail, normally within one business day. Use it for service questions, partnerships, press, careers, and to request the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment (topic: "assessment", with the company and main pipeline challenge in message). If the user only wants contact details, use vertodigital_get_contact instead. Call it only with the user's consent and their real name and email: every call creates a new enquiry (not idempotent, so do not retry a call that succeeded), and it is rate-limited, returning an isError result with a retry delay in seconds when the limit is hit. No authentication required.

fromEmail.description: Email address the team should reply to

fromName.description: Full name of the person sending the enquiry

topic.description: "assessment": request the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment. "services": questions about working with VertoDigital. "partnership", "press", "careers": as named. "general" (default): anything else.

name: vertodigital_send_enquiry
